```plato

    //==
    // # Feature combination

    // The two nearest feature distances combined as the chosen feature asks.
    // Precondition: f1 <= f2.
    WorleyCombine(f1: Number, f2: Number, feature: WorleyFeature): Number
        => match (feature) {
            F1 => f1;
            F2 => f2;
            F2MinusF1 => f2 - f1;
            F1PlusF2 => f1 + f2;
        };
```
